channel.title: Crypto Docket
channel.description: Crypto Docket reports news across crypto: Bitcoin and Ethereum, layer-2 networks, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation and security incidents.

item.title: How to revoke token approvals on BNB Chain for one token
item.description: To revoke token approvals on BNB Chain, select BNB Smart Chain, submit a wallet-signed revocation, then confirm the allowance is zero on-chain with BNB gas ready.

item.title: Automated market maker: how reserves set token prices
item.description: What is an automated market maker in crypto? It prices swaps from pool reserves: each trade changes the reserve ratio, moving the next quoted price.

item.title: Berachain bridge: move ETH to Berachain
item.description: seo_title: How to use Berachain bridge from Ethereum mainnet

item.title: What happens when an AMB destination contract call fails?
item.description: What happens when an AMB destination contract call fails? The receiver’s state change reverts; recovery depends on whether the relay records failure or reverts.

item.title: Wallet Disconnection and TRC-20 Allowances
item.description: Does disconnecting a wallet revoke token approvals? No: an existing TRC-20 allowance stays on-chain until it is spent, changed, or revoked in a transaction.

item.title: How do sidechain bridges differ from rollup bridges? Security, exits and speed
item.description: Sidechain vs rollup bridge differences come down to trust and exits: sidechains are fast and cheap, while rollups settle on Ethereum but can cost more or take longer to withdraw.

item.title: Token approval: What a DEX can do with your allowance
item.description: What can a token approval let a DEX do? It lets a named spender transfer one approved token from your wallet, up to the allowance you set on TRON.

item.title: Is SunSwap safe: what a first swap permits
item.description: Is SunSwap safe? It is non-custodial, but contract bugs, risky tokens and approvals can still put funds at risk. See what a first TRON swap permits.

item.title: US secures court authority over $1.2bn in Binance hack funds
item.description: US authorities have court approval to seize or restrain $1.2bn of Binance’s stolen crypto, part of $2.7bn frozen as tracing and recovery continue.

item.title: US targets $1.2bn of Binance hack funds for seizure
item.description: The US has court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2bn of the crypto stolen from Binance, while over $2.7bn has been frozen so far.

item.title: US wins authority over $1.2 billion in Binance hack funds
item.description: The Justice Department has court authority to seize or restrain $1.2 billion of Binance hack funds, while government and industry partners have frozen more than $2.7 billion.

item.title: US secures court authority over $1.2bn in Binance theft
item.description: US authorities have court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion in stolen Binance crypto, within a wider freeze exceeding $2.7 billion.

item.title: US secures authority to seize or restrain $1.2bn in Binance theft
item.description: US authorities won court approval to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion of stolen Binance crypto, while efforts to freeze and recover the rest continue.

item.title: US wins court authority over $1.2bn in Binance hack funds
item.description: The Justice Department has court approval to seize or restrain over $1.2 billion of Binance hack proceeds, part of $2.7 billion frozen as tracing continues.

item.title: US courts authorize seizure of $1.2bn in Binance hack
item.description: The Justice Department says courts have authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion from Binance’s $6.3 billion hack, while tracing continues.

item.title: US Secures Court Authority Over $1.2B in Binance Hack Crypto
item.description: US authorities secured court approval to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion in Binance hack proceeds; recovery now depends on tracing and forfeiture.

item.title: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody for European institutions
item.description: Deutsche Bank has opened crypto custody to European institutions and agreed to explore tokenized products with Deutsche Asset Management, moving from plan to service.

item.title: Deutsche Bank opens crypto custody to paying clients
item.description: Deutsche Bank opened custody to paying clients and signed an exploratory asset-management pact, extending bank-led crypto services while keeping the offer institutional.

item.title: Moody’s and Chainlink test multi-chain ratings delivery
item.description: Moody’s and Chainlink tested sending credit insights across multiple blockchains, extending beyond a single network but stopping short of live onchain ratings.

item.title: Treasury orders U.S. financial cutoff for MEXC over alleged $16B flows
item.description: FinCEN ordered U.S. firms to block transfers involving MEXC over alleged $16 billion in illicit flows, putting its U.S. financial access at stake once effective.
